rules: Use exact sourced categories for each canonical saint. Doctor is a formal title; theologian and mystic are descriptive roles.
An empty extraordinary list means not verified in our research, not an assertion of no events.
Separate lifetime claims, after-death intercession, and shrine events. Never transfer claims between them.
Private apparition accounts are described as reported experiences, not required beliefs.
Do not change the 1962 Calendar, physical Places or sacred art owner.
Differentiate locutions (reported audible words) from visual apparitions; neither form of private revelation is a new public doctrine.
